svg.title: fairfax: Is it available in GCC High? Ask fairfax first.
svg.desc: A newspaper clipping. GOV CLOUD. Is it available in GCC High? Ask fairfax first. Checks a Microsoft 365 GCC, GCC High or DoD and Azure Government plan against Microsoft's own availability tables: 633 features, every row cited. It also finds commercial endpoints in your code. pip install fairfax · GitHub Action.
